# Getting help

The hosted AgentCenter service has been shut down, so there is no paid support or support
mailbox. Help is community-driven and best-effort.

| You want to…                          | Go to                                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Ask a question or share a setup       | [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/discussions/categories/q-a)         |
| Propose an idea                       | [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/discussions/categories/ideas)     |
| Report a reproducible bug             | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/issues/new/choose)                  |
| Report a security vulnerability       | [Report privately](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/security/advisories/new) — never in public |

Before posting, search existing [issues](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and
[discussions](https://github.com/MissionControlSquad/agentcenter-self-hosting/discussions) — your question may already have an answer.
